dedupe_keys.name: ei sweden statistics and open data electricity gas and district heating network company data and electricity market data

description: The statistics and open data pages of the Swedish Energy Markets Inspectorate (Ei) bring together the regulator's data on energy network companies and the electricity market. The update table lists historical comparison prices of electricity contracts (monthly), customers by contract type from Statistics Sweden (every two months), network tariffs (yearly in March to April), smart grid indicators, economic and technical data for electricity network, gas network and district heating companies (yearly in October to November) and outage data on supply reliability of electricity network companies (yearly in December); there are also pages on network development plans. Ei catalogues its data sources under the DCAT-AP standard with access points or APIs, and the catalogue is harvested by the Swedish national data portal and the European data portal. Ei states that anyone may use, reuse and share its open data, which has no copyright, patent or confidentiality restrictions. Coverage is Sweden. Access is free. Caveats: most files are yearly Excel compilations of company reports, and the open data page was last reviewed on 9 June 2026. Simulation uses are network company statistics for gas, electricity and heat network models and reliability benchmarking. Related records: data-ei-sweden-electricity-supply-reliability-outage-statistics and data-ei-sweden-district-heating-technical-data are two of its data sets.
